title: Negotiating a project quote
objectives: Make acceptance conditional on the delivery date

courseTemplate.setting: The quote is twenty percent over budget. Replacing a custom dashboard with standard templates saves fifteen percent. The delivery date matters to the buyer.

roles.learner: A buyer negotiating with a supplier

courseTemplate.openingLine: Thanks for reviewing our proposal. What concerns do you have about the quote?

targetPatterns.pattern: The quote is twenty percent above our budget.
targetPatterns.example: The quote is twenty percent above our budget.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we replace the custom dashboard with standard reports?
targetPatterns.example: Could we replace the custom dashboard with standard reports?

targetPatterns.pattern: That could work if we confirm the delivery date in the contract.
targetPatterns.example: That could work if we confirm the delivery date in the contract.

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's kick off with the agenda.
targetPatterns.example: Let's kick off with the agenda.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we park this topic for now?
targetPatterns.example: Could we park this topic for now?
targetPatterns.translation: 这个话题先放一放好吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Just to summarize what we've agreed on...
targetPatterns.example: Just to summarize what we've agreed on...
targetPatterns.translation: 总结一下我们达成的共识……

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm afraid that's outside our budget range.
targetPatterns.example: I'm afraid that's outside our budget range.
targetPatterns.translation: 恐怕这超出了我们的预算范围。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could the folks who haven't spoken share their view?
targetPatterns.example: Could the folks who haven't spoken share their view?
targetPatterns.translation: 还没发言的同事能谈谈看法吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: To wrap up, here are the action items.
targetPatterns.example: To wrap up, here are the action items.

stages.title: State the budget gap clearly
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Thanks for reviewing our proposal. What concerns do you have about the quote?”
successCriteria: The learner can state the budget gap clearly in their own words.
hints: You can start with “The quote is twenty …”

stages.title: Suggest a specific scope change
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I understand. Are there parts of the scope you could adjust?”
successCriteria: The learner can suggest a specific scope change in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could we replace the …”

stages.title: Make acceptance conditional on the delivery date
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Standard templates would save fifteen percent. Would that work?”
successCriteria: The learner can make acceptance conditional on the delivery date in their own words.
hints: You can start with “That could work if …”

The quote is twenty percent above our budget.
I understand. Are there parts of the scope you could adjust?

Standard templates would save fifteen percent. Would that work?
That could work if we confirm the delivery date in the contract.
